author: YourFavPsycho
body:
Whilst playing destroy the monument i noticed many people being banned and kicked for 'the bedrock glitch'.At the time being half asleep i assumed they'd been doing something to do with the bottom layer of the map, as most have a starting layer of bedrock to keep from map destruction.
About 30 mins later after joining a new game i'd walked out of spawn and realised i'd picked some bedrock up off of the ground.Almost immediately i typed in chat 'umm', 'guys iv'e found some bedrock on the floor' ; to this no one commented neither players nor mods. So thinking it may have been some sort of mistake in the texture pack i use (as i have come across them before) i continue to play and build with the blocks.
Within seconds i was frozen and baned with the reasoning being 'Abusing Bedrock Glitch'.
With this happening within seconds it suggests the mod who banned me was watching and said nothing to me about it being a glitch.
